title: Blur Evaporate Out
description: Từng từ nhoè dần 10 px, bay lên 20 px rồi tan biến như bốc hơi, bắt đầu từ từ cuối.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-blur-evaporate-out, written here): Split words; from the last word backward, each word opacity 1 → 0, blur 0 → 10 px, y 0 → −20 px (0.4 em), 0.6 s ease-out (GSAP power1.out; demo 0.7 s easeOutQuad), stagger 50 ms from the end (demo 150 ms capped 0.6 s), from 0.9 s. Demo adds 7 seeded dust dots per word (0.8–2.2 px, muted) rising 0.5–1.3 em with opacity 0.8·sin(π·p). Loop: text fades back 2.4–2.9 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.6 s) · stagger: từ cuối (0.05 s) · blur (10 px) · y (−20 px).
